lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Files_external_gdrive_v2\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

1 class in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\Files_external_gdrive_v2, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/Controller/OauthController.php:47 OCP\AppFramework\Http\Attribute\NoSameSiteCookieRequired: there since Nextcloud 34, the app declares from 33
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that the oldest majors of Nextcloud 33 to 34 do not have yet. Either min-version in appinfo/info.xml goes up, or the app does without it there.

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 1 place. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 1 place. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
